_readme: What Elliot is into this week. There is no feed for this — he does not read books, and nothing he does leaves a trail that says what he is thinking about — so it is the one live line that is written by hand. The panel files it under Notion, which is where the note lives; the site does not read Notion itself, so this file has to be kept in step with the page there. Edit 'interested', set 'since' to today, push: the deploy is the update. 'since' is the date it was written; the panel does not show it, so keep it honest by keeping it current. 'link' is optional: something to read on it. Keep it to one clause; it is a line, not a paragraph.
